en: A black‑and‑white view through tall leafy trees of a landscaped park or garden, with lawns, shrubs, and flowerbeds in the foreground. In the background, partly hidden by the trees, stands a large late‑19th‑century style building with arched windows, a steep roof, and a tower-like gable topped by a slender spire or finial. The image has wide borders like an old photographic postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.
